question: Which divine protectors are invoked to guard the throat and face?
premises: The throat is to be protected by the world-protector.
The face is to be protected by the all-seer.
The all-pervading one is invoked as protector.
inference: Therefore, specific divine aspects are called upon to protect specific body parts.
plain_english: May the protector of the world protect the throat; may the all-seeing, all-pervading one protect the face.
